"Right opportunity ka wait mat karo."
"Motivation chalayegi, habit grow karayegi."
Mind enlightened ho jaye—phir unenlightened nahi hota.
Samajhdaar bano.
Madadgar bano.
Kal ko realize karne ki limit aaj ke doubts hain.
"Success selected few ke liye nahi."
Baat chhoro, kaam shuru karo.
Tumhe badi shiddat se chahiye.
Kitne saal jiye wo nahi, zindagi mein kitna jee liye wo zaruri hai.
Main taiyari karunga aur ek din mera avsar zaroor aayega.
